_note: Everything account-specific lives here so a customer version is just a different brand.json.
_fontsNote: 2026-10 rebrand (vault brand/visual-system.md): Jost for running text, labels and highlight text; Instrument Serif for headlines, big numbers and the italic key word. Bricolage Grotesque and Figtree are retired.

tigerNod._note: Small, tasteful, CTA slide or caption only, at most once per post. Rotate.

palettes._note: 2026-10 rebrand (vault brand/visual-system.md; look frozen 2026-10-22). Roles: bg, ink (text), accent (the *italic* word and big numbers), mark (sky marker band under the italic word; transparent on navy, where the word turns sky instead), deco (arrows, sparkles, stars), tex (pattern lines), paper/paperInk/paperAccent/paperMark (notes, cards, checklist rows, polaroids). Mix across the feed like the site: mostly offwhite, navy often, mist now and then. Hot pink #ff3b7f means Mercedes: only on slides about her or in her voice, and only on navy (never pink text on light grounds). Retired: orange #E05A33, tangerine, peach, blush, cream #F6EEE5, ink #161210.

paletteAliases._note: Old palette names from before the 2026-10 rebrand, so older post.json and ledger entries still render.

_pinkNote: Hot pink = Mercedes only (her name, her story, her quotes, her sign-off), as text or accents on navy grounds. Never on products, prices, Clubs, tools or CTAs. Use with palette navy + slide/post "voice": "mercedes".
